title: Barrel moving-ADS spread tier fields and owner-collection source review

finding.rawProof: Exact selector references under GS Class_539cff9b/Field_2ffeb6ac were followed to GDM_Array_ADSMoveDispersion objects. Descriptor-derived raw field bytes, decoded source values, current XML values, and site tier value agree for the three matching site leaves.
finding.unresolved: Eight site-zero leaves have selected weapons but no matching GDM_Array_ADSMoveDispersion selector reference in the identified moving-ADS owner collection Field_2ffeb6ac. Exact selector refs in sibling Field_b30a73ed are recorded separately because the SDK evidence leaves that collection's target unknown. Other source paths and native consumer behavior are not ruled out. BARRELS/0 has no selected weapon choices in the exact site map.

limits: Collection identity comes from current SDK reflection: Field_2ffeb6ac is the moving-ADS collection; Field_b30a73ed has a distinct element type and unknown runtime target. A GDM filename match without the owner collection is not accepted.
The source review closes three matching leaves and identifies a collection-specific source gap for eight; it does not prove source absence or baseline runtime behavior.
No runtime or gameplay claim is made.
